_comment: Work order 'bulk sourcing' recipe set. The search base filters (titles, headcount slices, founded years, countries) live in profiles/<name>.toml [icp] and are merged into every recipe by tools/run_bulk_sourcing.py; only q_keywords varies here. Narrow verticals run first (cheap, near-zero competitors), broad sweeps after (volume, aggressive prefilter). Founded-year 2020-2026 chosen after a free plan pass: 2023-2026 gave ~300 enrichable, 2020-2026 ~530 (fits the 1,000-credit run cap), none ~1,300 (exceeds it).
